title: Painting a Farm Road in Gouache
content: Painting is a kind of magic trick where you invite the viewer to travel through the surface into a world or feeling and imagination. (Link to video on YouTube)Open Road,gouache, 5 x 8 inchesIn the video I reference an excerpt fromJohn O'Donahue's poem "For the Senses"May your inner eyeSee through the surfacesAnd glean the real presenceOf everything that meets you.May your soul beautifyThe desire of your eyesThat you might glimpseThe infinity that hidesIn the simple sightsThat seem wornTo your usual eyes-----CBC Interview with John O'Donahue(Thanks, Fhinn)
